criterion: References stocklock/inventory.py (InventoryTable, SkuSlot, reserve_items) and examines how multi-item cart reservations acquire locks and validate stock.
Presents the case for optimistic concurrency: avoids lock-ordering deadlock risks across multi-SKU carts and eliminates blocking overhead when contention across distinct SKUs is low.

Presents the counter-case under flash-sale skew: when hundreds of callers contend for the same hot SKU, optimistic CAS retries suffer livelock and wasted work whereas serialized per-SKU locking makes guaranteed progress.
Contrasts multi-SKU cart lock ordering (which sorted key acquisition solves in pessimistic mode) against hot-key retry storms in optimistic mode.
States a clear decision rule based on contention skew and retry budget (e.g., sorted per-SKU pessimistic locks for hot flash-sale SKUs vs optimistic version checks for long-tail catalog items).
